guard_admission.enforced_by: code_review_bundle_guard.admission_exit_code, called by the runner AFTER the test session and INDEPENDENTLY of its result. A library can catch a refusal, substitute a fallback and let every test pass -- which is what retired N14-BUNDLE-010 -- so the exit code is not inferred from the test outcome.
guard_admission.first_initialization_tracking: ATTEMPTED at lifecycle START, not on completion. A module key is marked the moment its first eligible extent begins, so the extent that ends by RAISING has still spent the module's one chance. Reload, re-import, a retry after a failed initialisation, and any later call into an initialised module are all outside the extent.
guard_admission.native_resolution_extent: ctypes.* stays denied as a family, with one extent carved out: ctypes.dlopen and ctypes.dlsym are permitted only while a pinned RUNTIME module runs its FIRST normal initialisation on this thread, only when every Python frame between the call and that initialisation is runtime code or the interpreter's own import machinery, and only when the library resolves into the runtime tree or a protected system location.
guard_admission.not_claimed: co_filename is writable by code that builds its own code objects, so in-process adversarial code can forge RUNTIME provenance. That is the boundary the project already ratified (L6 R18) and this does not move it. What it does defend against is a refusal that changes execution semantics and is then absorbed by the caller.
guard_admission.prescribed_negative_controls: each sealed control DECLARES the refusal it is about to cause, before causing it, through guard.expect(event, contains, prescribed_by, why). The guard attributes every refusal against those declarations; anything unmatched is UNEXPECTED.
guard_admission.protected_system_locations: System32 and SysWOW64 under the SystemRoot read from HKLM through winreg -- not from the SystemRoot environment variable, for the same reason the review workspace stopped reading TMP.
guard_admission.provenance_source: WHERE CODE WAS LOADED FROM. A name supplied by executing code is not provenance, and generated or unregistered code -- anything without a real load location -- acquires none.
guard_admission.runtime_tree_untouched: the loader wrapping is an in-process wrapper on three importlib loader classes. No file in N14-RUNTIME-001 changes, and the runtime still re-hashes all 12002 of its own files at launch.
guard_admission.stop_condition: NOT 'a guard denial exists'. STOP on a launcher/runtime refusal, on a non-empty unexpected_denials, on a non-empty missing_prescribed_denials, or on an expected denial whose declaration does not match what happened.
guard_admission.thread_scope: extents are thread-local; a new thread inherits none. The attempted set is process-wide, because sys.modules is.

verification_targets.builder_claim: `RunnerResult.grid_evidence_by_seed` carries every governed seed and every cell; a marked cell carries reason, detail and the frozen counts and carries no statistics keys at all.
verification_targets.closure_requires: Final output must retain/report the full required per-seed grid evidence, including marked-cell absence metadata and the reason/detail the governed reporting contract requires, with NO invented values for marked cells, and merged region maps must remain available without replacing the per-seed report.
verification_targets.frozen_finding: Producer objects contain the complete per-seed/cell marked and absence metadata, but the final RunnerResult/return path discards that detail and retains only merged/base summaries.
verification_targets.title: Final runner output drops required full per-seed grid reporting

write_surfaces.base_is_not_a_read_root: the guard admits the frozen CHILD and nothing else outside the bundle and the runtime. The supplied base is stat'd, never listed: no sibling enumeration, no unrelated read, no part of it usable as review input.
write_surfaces.bytecode: sys.dont_write_bytecode is set by the runner itself, so nothing is written into the sealed tree or the runtime even if the runner is invoked without the launcher's -B.
write_surfaces.child_is_fresh: the child must not exist. It is refused even if it exists EMPTY, is never reused, and is never deleted by the runner: an empty directory is not evidence that it is unused, and removing another attempt's directory is worse than refusing.
write_surfaces.ephemeral_scratch: <review output root>/.scratch/ -- a dot directory beside the returns, never inside them. pytest's basetemp is pinned into it.
write_surfaces.forbidden_workspace_roots_note: DECLARED here because a sealed object cannot derive them from its own location. The sealed delivery, the review-delivery directory it sits in and the portable runtime beside it are DERIVED at runtime instead, so they stay correct if the delivery moves. Overlap is refused in both directions: a base inside one of these would put reviewer output in a governed place, and a base containing one would put a governed place inside the writable surface.
write_surfaces.output_binding: OUTPUT_BINDING.json in the child names REVIEW_ID, MANIFEST_SHA256, RUNTIME_MANIFEST_SHA256 and the substantive round. The runner refuses a workspace bound to any other review object, so one delivery's artifacts cannot be read as another's. The absolute path is execution provenance and is deliberately NOT part of the review identity: two seats may run this delivery at different paths and review the same bytes.
write_surfaces.read_boundary: the output root is an OUTPUT surface only. The guard admits that one directory and nothing else outside the bundle and the runtime, so temp siblings cannot be enumerated, read, or used as an input source.
write_surfaces.review_output_root: EXPLICITLY SUPPLIED BY THE DISPATCHER, never discovered. run_review.cmd requires --review-output-base <authorized writable base> and passes it to the runner, which canonicalises it, proves it is disjoint in BOTH directions from every forbidden root, creates exactly one FRESH child <base>/itsf-review/<REVIEW_ID>-<first 12 of MANIFEST_SHA256>, and proves CREATE/WRITE/RENAME/DELETE there by performing them. No default, no fallback, no environment read, no known folder, no profile inference: a missing parameter is a DELIVERY FAILURE before the guard arms. No username and no absolute workspace path enters the contract.

scratch_lifecycle.after_failure: KEPT for diagnosis and labelled EPHEMERAL_DO_NOT_READ_AS_EVIDENCE.txt
scratch_lifecycle.after_success: REMOVED by the runner, walking and unlinking
scratch_lifecycle.before: created empty by the runner inside the fresh child, before the guard arms. Nothing pre-exists it, because the child itself is new.
scratch_lifecycle.during: the only place temporary files may exist

write_surfaces.sealed_payload: IMMUTABLE to review execution. The seat runs under a RESTRICTED Windows token and proved that the bundle path stays unwritable to it even with an ordinary Modify ACE present, so no in-bundle surface is declared writable and none is granted. The guard additionally denies every mutating event outside the resolved output root.
write_surfaces.workspace_authority: EXPLICIT_DISPATCH_PARAMETER. TMP, TEMP and TMPDIR are SET by the runner to the validated child after it is frozen -- output routing -- and are never READ to select authority.
